answer: An economy trading comet trajectories and umber pigment data can gate voting with anonymous uniqueness credentials. An independent registrar issues one credential per verified operator. Each voting vertex proves possession and publishes a deterministic, epoch-specific nullifier; duplicate nullifiers are rejected across account keys. A farm must recruit additional verified operators or corrupt the registrar, rather than generate free aliases. This preserves pseudonyms but depends on reliable deduplication and registrar audits.
